headline: 1986 Fleer Michael Jordan #57 raw
why: Ask sits under a tight raw band. Pop 312 is the 10 census — do not confuse that with raw supply.

headline: Base Set Charizard #4 unlimited
why: Classic trap: pay over raw comps, then add Priority fees, into a 18k pop.

headline: Amazing Spider-Man #1 (1963)
why: In-band on a thin key. Hold — you are not being paid to take restoration risk.

headline: 1952 Topps Mickey Mantle #311
why: Ask is ~2× the sold band. Famous card ≠ automatic deal.

headline: Alpha Black Lotus
why: Hold. You can be right on price and still wait a year for the next check.

headline: Incredible Hulk #181 (1974)
why: Buy the book, skip the slab. Discount to raw solds is the whole trade.

headline: 2003 Topps Chrome LeBron #111
why: Hold / pass on grading. You are buying a liquid raw card, not a 10 ticket.

headline: Blue-Eyes White Dragon LOB-001
why: Pass. Name the print or you overpay. 1st Edition is a different SKU (id 2530687).

headline: Base Set Charizard #4 1st Edition
why: Buy now on raw vs a real 1st band — after you have named the print.

headline: Prismatic Evolutions ETB (sealed)
why: Pass. Modern sealed after the chase window is how rooms fill with dead cardboard.
